title: Outer R2DBC transactions remain active after nested savepoints
summary: Both nested R2DBC scopes preserved the enclosing transaction on the merge. Its outer rollback removed even the successful inner write.

change.description: A completed PROPAGATION_NESTED scope now releases its savepoint during cleanup and preserves the outer connection holder. This matters when another nested scope or more SQL follows the first.

notes: DatabaseClient uses the same connection factory as the transaction manager. The wrapper forwards to R2DBC H2, counts completed transaction and savepoint operations, and leaves the independent reader outside the transaction.
